rafa: FYI planning a rolling node reboot window in eu-west1 on 2026-04-18 23:00-00:30 UTC. Will do conservative interleaved drains + temporary egress shift. Thread for ops coordination. cc @marta @andy

ops-bot: maintenance-scheduler created event maint-179500 for 2026-04-18 23:00-00:30 UTC. Owners notified.

marta: Which rack(s) for canary and cadence?

rafa: Canary rack is rack-05. We cap drain to <=10% per hosted pool. Cadence: 1 node per rack, 8min spacing between reboots, automated KV warmseed after each rack. High-level timeline:

23:00-23:10 UTC - rack-05 canary drain/reboot/healthcheck
23:10-00:10 UTC - interleaved reboots across [rack-05,rack-11,rack-19,rack-02]
00:10-00:20 UTC - kv-cache warmseed + smoke tests
00:20-00:30 UTC - revert egress routing and close event

andy: I'll run kvseed: `tools/kvseed/warm_top_prefixes.sh --top 30 --parallel 4` starting 22:40 UTC so caches finish before canary completes.

dana: Cost note: spot backfill OK for non-prod pools; for customer-critical pools consider short dedicated burst to avoid tail errors. Estimate +5% unit-cost if we use mixed spots. Decision by EOD Fri.

marta: I'll publish brief tenant blurb and add runbook link here once posted. Runbook will include rollback thresholds: p99 token latency +200ms or error rate +3% absolute -> abort/rollback.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled - maint-179500 24h reminder sent to owners.
